structured_output.summary: All behaviour criteria are exercised by tests whose assertions would fail if the behaviour broke. I found no blocking issues. The advisories are one deleted assertion and a few small untested edges.

findings.text: The deleted test_etag_response_412 asserted that a 412 response from make_conditional still has a body ('Make sure there is a body still'). The new deprecated-path test only checks status_code == 412.
No test combines If-Range with send_file, or checks that apply_conditions's 304 keeps working with a Range header present. Both are interactions between the new methods and send_file.

The old_accept_ranges save and restore in make_conditional is a workaround for apply_conditions always setting Accept-Ranges. It is only needed to keep the deprecated method's legacy behaviour of not advertising ranges when accept_ranges is falsy.

coverage.note: I did not read the exact assertion line. Failure of If-Match and If-Unmodified-Since on every method, the If-None-Match 412 on non-GET/HEAD, the star ETag with exists, and the RFC ordering are each asserted in the parametrized apply_conditions tests.
Asserts a 304, Accept-Ranges: bytes, and Content-Length absent after from_app. The If-None-Match and If-Modified-Since GET/HEAD cases are in dedicated tests.
Non-GET is left unchanged with Accept-Ranges set. Separate tests cover non-200, unknown length and zero length.
Covers clamping. The first-range-only, unsatisfiable (416), 206 Content-Range and non-bytes-unit cases have their own tests.
Covers a matching ETag, a mismatch, and a weak ETag. test_apply_range_if_range_date covers the date match, mismatch and missing Last-Modified.
Uses pytest.deprecated_call and also asserts the old behaviour still works. The http.py deprecations are tested in test_http.py.

Covers clamping of stop and suffix, first range only, and the unsatisfiable cases. test_etag_set_discards_unquoted covers ETagSet, and the existing ContentRange.from_header tests in test_http.py cover its validation.
Parametrized over strong, weak and mismatched ETags, equal and different dates, naive datetimes with microseconds, and missing values.

Detection of name, size and mtime is covered here. Seek is covered by test_object_seeks_to_start and test_object_range, the ETag by test_etag, and the octet-stream default by test_object_without_mimetype.
Covers the warnings for cache and fallback_mimetype. test_no_max_age_by_default, test_conditional, test_range and test_range_not_satisfiable cover the other behaviour.
New apply_conditions and apply_range tests exist, the send_file tests are updated, and the deprecated-function tests are moved or filtered.
